name: Daily Post Ideas
subtitle: What to post today, drafted and ready to schedule.
summary: Checks what's already in your queue and what has worked for you lately, then drafts 2-3 posts in your voice for you to pick from and schedule.
provide: optionally a topic or product to focus on.
get: 2-3 drafts on a picker card, then scheduling from an approval card.
launchPrompt: What should I post today? Check my queue and recent performance, then draft 2-3 options I can schedule.
